ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub EDRKillShifter BYOVD — vulnerable-driver drop + kernel service registration
ucs.description: Hunts RansomHub's signature defense-evasion loader EDRKillShifter (Sophos, Aug-2024): a user-mode binary drops a vulnerable signed driver (RentDrv2 / ThreatFireMonitor / ZAM64 variants) into a user-writable directory and immediately registers it as a kernel-mode service via sc.exe or a direct write of the Services\<X>\ImagePath value, then loads it to terminate EDR processes. The chained drop→service-create within minutes is highly RansomHub-specific and rarely seen outside BYOVD loaders.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as drop_time values(Filesystem.process_name) as loader values(Filesystem.user) as user values(Filesystem.file_path) as driver_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*.sys" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*") AND NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("MsMpEng.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","svchost.exe","drvinst.exe","msiexec.exe","TiWorker.exe","SetupHost.exe") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as svc_time values(Processes.process) as svc_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="sc.exe" AND Processes.process="*create*" AND (Processes.process="*type= kernel*" OR Processes.process="*binPath=*" OR Processes.process="*start= demand*") by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | where svc_time>=drop_time AND svc_time<=drop_time+900 | sort -drop_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let DriverDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FileName endswith ".sys"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("MsMpEng.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","svchost.exe","drvinst.exe","msiexec.exe","TiWorker.exe","SetupHost.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DropTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DriverFile=FileName, DriverFullPath=strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName),
              LoaderProcess=InitiatingProcessFileName, LoaderCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              LoaderSHA256=InitiatingProcessSHA256, DriverSHA256=SHA256,
              AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let DriverServiceReg = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RegistryKey has @"\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\"
    | where RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
    | where RegistryValueData has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\")
    | where RegistryValueData has ".sys"
    | project RegTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, ServiceKey=RegistryKey, ImagePath=RegistryValueData,
              ServiceWriter=InitiatingProcessFileName, ServiceWriterCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
DriverDrops
| join kind=inner DriverServiceReg on DeviceId
| where RegTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + 15m)        // 15m = empirical EDRKillShifter drop→load window
| where ImagePath contains DriverFile
| project DropTime, RegTime, DeviceName, AccountName, LoaderProcess, LoaderCmd,
          DriverFile, DriverFullPath, ServiceKey, ImagePath, ServiceWriter,
          LoaderSHA256, DriverSHA256
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let DriverDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FileName endswith ".sys"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("MsMpEng.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","svchost.exe","drvinst.exe","msiexec.exe","TiWorker.exe")
    | project DropTime=TimeGenerated, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DriverFile=FileName, DriverFullPath=strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName),
              LoaderProcess=InitiatingProcessFileName, LoaderCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let KernelServiceCreate = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\sc.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "create" and (CommandLine has "type= kernel" or CommandLine has "binPath=")
    | extend DeviceName = Computer
    | project SvcTime=TimeGenerated, DeviceName, ServiceCmd=CommandLine, ServiceUser=SubjectUserName;
DriverDrops
| join kind=inner KernelServiceCreate on DeviceName
| where SvcTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + 15m)
| where ServiceCmd contains DriverFile
| project DropTime, SvcTime, DeviceName, ServiceUser, LoaderProcess, LoaderCmd,
          DriverFile, DriverFullPath, ServiceCmd
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BYOVD Kernel Service Registered with ImagePath in User-Writable Location (RansomHub EDRKillShifter)
id: 9d5c3c4b-1a72-4f6e-a5dc-ransomhub-edrkillshifter
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of a Windows kernel service whose ImagePath points to a .sys file under Public/Temp/ProgramData. Signature TTP of RansomHub's EDRKillShifter loader (Sophos, Aug-2024) which drops a vulnerable signed driver and registers it to neutralise EDR.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/14/edrkillshifter-a-new-category-of-edr-killers/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1543.003
  - attack.t1068
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: registry_set
detection:
  selection_key:
    TargetObject|contains: '\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\'
    TargetObject|endswith: '\ImagePath'
  selection_driver_path:
    Details|contains:
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
    Details|endswith: '.sys'
  filter_trusted_installer:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
      - '\drvinst.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\svchost.exe'
      - '\TiWorker.exe'
  condition: selection_key and selection_driver_path and not filter_trusted_installer
falsepositives:
  - Rare third-party installers staging signed drivers outside %SystemRoot%\System32\drivers\
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*\\ImagePath OR *\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*\\ImagePath) @Details:(*\\Users\\Public\\*.sys OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*.sys OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\*.sys OR *\\ProgramData\\*.sys OR *\\users\\public\\*.sys OR *\\appdata\\local\\temp\\*.sys OR *\\windows\\temp\\*.sys OR *\\programdata\\*.sys) -@Image:(*\\TrustedInstaller.exe OR *\\trustedinstaller.exe OR *\\TRUSTEDINSTALLER.EXE OR *\\drvinst.exe OR *\\DrvInst.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\svchost.exe OR *\\SVCHOST.EXE OR *\\TiWorker.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\.sys$/i
| regex("\\\\(Users\\\\Public|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|Windows\\\\Temp|ProgramData)\\\\", field=TargetFileName, flags="i")
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(TrustedInstaller|svchost|drvinst|msiexec|TiWorker|MsMpEng|SetupHost)\.exe$/i
| join({
    #event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate
    RegObjectName=/\\Services\\/i
    RegValueName=/ImagePath/i
    RegStringValue=/\\(Users\\Public|AppData\\Local\\Temp|Windows\\Temp|ProgramData)\\.+\.sys/i
  }, field=aid, include=[RegObjectName, RegStringValue, RegValueName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, RegObjectName, RegStringValue], function=[min(@timestamp, as=first_seen), max(@timestamp, as=last_seen)])
ucs.rationale: RansomHub is the only major RaaS shipping a built-in BYOVD loader (EDRKillShifter) to every affiliate. Other RaaS crews historically used standalone tools (Backstab/AuKill) that look different on disk. The drop-to-user-writable-path + service registration referencing the same .sys within minutes is the canonical EDRKillShifter execution profile documented by Sophos and CISA AA24-242A. Filtering on

ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub pre-encryption recovery-inhibition chain (vssadmin + bcdedit + iisreset + wbadmin)
ucs.description: Detects RansomHub's distinctive cluster of recovery-destruction commands fired in tight succession from the same host immediately before encryption — CISA AA24-242A documents the exact sequence: vssadmin delete shadows + wmic shadowcopy delete + bcdedit safeboot/recoveryenabled + iisreset /stop + wevtutil cl. The combined `iisreset /stop` with VSS deletion is RansomHub-specific (BlackCat/LockBit don't typically iisreset; Akira doesn't bcdedit safeboot). ≥3 distinct indicators within 10 minutes from one device is high-fidelity pre-detonation telemetry.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as bins values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_bins from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*" OR Processes.process="*safeboot*")) OR (Processes.process_name="iisreset.exe" AND Processes.process="*/stop*") OR (Processes.process_name="wevtutil.exe" AND Processes.process="* cl *")) AND NOT Processes.user="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where distinct_bins>=3 | sort -_time
ucs.kql:
let WindowMinutes = 10m;     // 10m = empirical RansomHub pre-encryption execution span
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","delete catalog"))
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"      and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe"   and ProcessCommandLine has "delete catalog")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"   and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("bootstatuspolicy","recoveryenabled","safeboot"))
     or (FileName =~ "iisreset.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has "/stop")
     or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has " cl ")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend Indicator = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe",  "vss_delete",
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe",      "wmic_shadow_delete",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe",   "wbadmin_catalog_delete",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe",   "bcdedit_recovery_off",
    FileName =~ "iisreset.exe",  "iis_stop",
    FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe",  "evt_clear",
    "other")
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp),
            IndicatorCount=dcount(Indicator),
            Indicators=make_set(Indicator),
            SampleCmds=make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20),
            Parents=make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10),
            User=any(AccountName)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where IndicatorCount >= 3     // 3 = P99 of any legitimate admin script in baseline
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe"  and (CommandLine has "delete shadows" or CommandLine has "delete catalog"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe"      and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe"   and CommandLine has "delete catalog")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"   and (CommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy" or CommandLine has "recoveryenabled" or CommandLine has "safeboot"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\iisreset.exe"  and CommandLine has "/stop")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wevtutil.exe"  and CommandLine has " cl ")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| extend Indicator = case(
    NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe",  "vss_delete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe",      "wmic_shadow_delete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe",   "wbadmin_catalog_delete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe",   "bcdedit_recovery_off",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\iisreset.exe",  "iis_stop",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\wevtutil.exe",  "evt_clear",
    "other")
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated),
            IndicatorCount=dcount(Indicator),
            Indicators=make_set(Indicator),
            SampleCmds=make_set(CommandLine, 20),
            Parents=make_set(ParentProcessName, 10),
            User=any(SubjectUserName)
            by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where IndicatorCount >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"delete catalog"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE OR *\\WMIC.exe) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy* AND @CommandLine:*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*"delete catalog"*) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*bootstatuspolicy* OR *recoveryenabled* OR *safeboot*)) OR (@Image:(*\\iisreset.exe OR *\\IISReset.exe OR *\\IISRESET.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*"/stop"*) OR (@Image:(*\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\WevtUtil.exe OR *\\WEVTUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*" cl "*)) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR "LOCAL SERVICE" OR "NETWORK SERVICE")
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (
    (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+(shadows|catalog)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy.*delete/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+catalog/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(bootstatuspolicy|recoveryenabled|safeboot)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\iisreset\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/\/stop/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wevtutil\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/\bcl\b/i)
  )
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| ind := regex("\\\\(?<bin>vssadmin|wmic|wbadmin|bcdedit|iisreset|wevtutil)\\.exe", field=ImageFileName, flags="i", strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[count(field=bin, distinct=true, as=distinct_bins), collect([CommandLine, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName]), min(@timestamp, as=first_seen), max(@timestamp, as=last_seen)])
| distinct_bins >= 3
ucs.rationale: This is RansomHub's documented pre-detonation playbook from CISA #StopRansomware AA24-242A and Symantec/Mandiant intrusion reports. Legitimate backup operations touch ONE of these binaries (e.g. wbadmin scheduled job); legitimate admin scripts rarely touch ≥3 in a 10-minute window, and never combine `iisreset /stop` with VSS deletion + bcdedit safeboot — that triad is the RansomHub signature.
